description: TerraShift+ turns NASA Earth observations into a human story of generational farming resilience. Inspired by families navigating erratic rainfall and soil depletion, our mission bridges satellites (SMAP, POWER, ECOSTRESS) with soil biology to craft 5-year regenerative crop rotations. We are AI, MLOps, and software engineers seeking passionate storytellers, creative communicators, and agronomists to transform scientific data into a compelling global narrative for farmers in Africa and worldwide.
summary: TerraShift+ is a bilingual (English and Tanzanian Swahili) crop-rotation decision-support workstation built for smallholder and commercial farmers facing shifting rainfall, heat extremes, and bare-soil erosion. When a user clicks any farm on the map, searches a village, or uses GPS, TerraShift+ streams live NASA Earth observations (NASA POWER, SMAP L4, GPM IMERG, MODIS NDVI, ECOSTRESS, GEDI, and SRTM/DEM) paired with African 30m iSDAsoil and global ISRIC SoilGrids baselines. Rather than black-box AI guessing, TerraShift+ couples satellite telemetry with deterministic biophysical laws—FAO-56 Penman-Monteith evapotranspiration, Saxton-Rawls hydrology, GDD/KDD, RUSLE erosion, and RothC carbon balance—alongside quantile regression uncertainty bands (P10/P50/P90), Monte Carlo CVaR10 risk scoring, and Out-of-Distribution safeguards. It compares the farmer's existing baseline against three adaptive rotations, highlighting bare-field windows, supporting evidence, data gaps, and local review risks without replacing farmer or extension-officer judgment.
details:
How TerraShift+ Works

TerraShift+ helps farmers and extension officers (Maafisa Ugani) move from guesswork to evidence-based multi-year crop planning in four steps:

  1. Locate Any Field: Opening the app automatically centers on the user's region via edge geolocation, or farmers can search a village, use device GPS, or draw a parcel boundary on the map.
  2. Diagnose Seasonal Risks: The platform turns satellite weather, moisture, greenness, and elevation terrain into plain-language findings—pinpointing months when fields sit bare, heat or frost windows, 5-year climatic trends, and a 3×3 sub-field slope and runoff grid.
  3. Add Local Farm Realities: Because satellites cannot see every management practice, farmers adjust water access, no-till equipment availability, livestock forage needs, personal priorities, and local soil-test measurements (pH, texture, organic carbon).
  4. Compare Four Rotation Paths: Rather than prescribing one rigid answer, TerraShift+ compares the farm's existing crop baseline against three alternatives (Resilience-First, Balanced Stewardship, and Yield-Maximizing)—showing expected 5-year margins alongside downside drought protection, soil loss reduction, nitrogen recovery, information gaps, and local review checks.

Measured Impact & Field Validation

  • Dodoma, Tanzania: A legume-millet rotation lowers modeled soil loss by 50.6% (10.31 to 5.09 t/ha/yr), shifts 5-year soil nitrogen from -175 to +145 kg/ha, and raises projected 5-year margin by 35%.
  • Fallon, Nevada & Ames, Iowa: Diversified sequences halve topsoil erosion under arid Western U.S. conditions (127.5 mm/yr rain) and reverse nitrogen depletion in Corn Belt monocultures.
  • Safety Under Extremes: Testing against a Polar negative control (-78.34°) triggers an Out-of-Distribution warning instead of fabricating crop advice, and -25% rainfall stress tests confirm 100% consistent water-stress responses.

What Makes It Creative & Farmer-Centered

  • Bilingual Tanzanian Swahili & English: The full interface and interactive Field Advisor operate seamlessly in both English and natural Tanzanian Swahili (sw-TZ), translating technical terms into clear farming guidance.
  • Grounded Field Advisor: When farmers ask questions in either language, the advisor queries live mission telemetry and renders sub-field heatmaps and satellite previews directly in the conversation rather than generating unverified claims.
  • Full Technical Paper: Complete equations, validation tables, and reproducibility benchmarks are published in the TerraShift+ Technical Research Paper.

Build Architecture

  • Frontend & Documentation: React, Vite, Leaflet, bilingual EN/SW interface, and OpenAPI 3.1 Swagger docs.
  • Modeling & Edge APIs: Python 3.14, FastAPI, scikit-learn, SciPy, and NumPy for offline model training and validation, paired with Cloudflare Pages Functions (/functions/api/*) for live multi-source streaming on a single public domain.
  • Reliability & Access: Publicly open with zero logins or passwords, strict environment-secret isolation, and automated testing across real streaming endpoints.
